data.one_liner: Permissive and performant mapping library supporting Mapbox Vector Tiles.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter bindings for native MapLibre SDKs using FFI/JNI to deliver cross-platform map rendering, custom styling, vector tiles, and advanced mapping features. Uses MapLibre GL JS on the web and through a WebView on desktop.
use_when: You need high-performance cross-platform vector tile maps in your Flutter app.
You want an open-source mapping library powered by native MapLibre SDKs.
avoid_when: You rely on Google Maps proprietary features or built-in Google services.
You require robust desktop support without WebView dependencies.
strengths: Native interoperability (FFI/JNI) for consistent cross-platform performance on mobile.
Supports advanced mapping features like 3D building outlines, heatmaps, and custom vector styles.
weaknesses: Desktop platforms (Windows and macOS) rely on a WebView running maplibre-gl-js.
Requires managing specific native SDK versions and platform configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup for Android and iOS as documented in the get-started guide.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: A pure Dart mapping solution using tile layers without native SDK dependencies.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need the official Google Maps SDK integration.

alternatives.name: maplibre_gl
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are maintaining an older project using the legacy package that this library modernizes.
